mentions.name: Where the Heck?
mentions.description: A geography puzzle game (working title) based on the relative positions of cities, towns, landmarks, and points of interest in Yorkshire, with other territories planned. It experiments with OpenStreetMap data to test local knowledge in novel and interesting ways; an initial prototype is expected soon.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've begun a new puzzle based on the relative positions of cities, towns, landmarks, and points of interest in my native Yorkshire (likely to be followed by other territories). I'm experimenting with different ways of using Openstreetmap data to make something that tests local knowledge in novel and interesting ways. Working title: Where the Heck? An initial prototype will be ready soon.
